about.title: About Player Zero
about.description: Player Zero is an independent developer of games and apps, currently making KEYCERTO and Meloom.
about.lead: Player Zero is an independent developer of games and apps.
paragraphs: We are currently making two projects. KEYCERTO is a rhythm game played on the keyboard, in development for Windows PC on Steam. Meloom is a companion app for Android and Windows that shows your day as a room.

They are quite different from each other. In KEYCERTO, keeping time with the music writes letters and short stories onto paper, and you can play with one key, two keys or by typing the English text yourself. In Meloom, the weather, the local time and, if you choose, your calendar appear in a small room where you can open gifts and card packs and collect cards.
Neither project has a release date yet. When there is news, it will appear on this site first. You can also follow development on our YouTube channel, Player Zero Dev (@player0dev).
